title: Setup system and run MD simulations
action: Set up a 2D hexagonal lattice of 256 atoms with Lennard-Jones potential (σ_A=1, atomic size ratio α=0.75, ε_AA=ε_AB=ε_BB) at temperature T=0.25 (reduced units) and pressure P=0.0. For each solute concentration X_B in {0.10, 0.148, 0.172, 0.25}, generate random initial configurations and perform constant-T, constant-P molecular dynamics until equilibrium. Output the trajectories or final configurations needed for correlation analysis.
description: Core MD simulation stage that produces the atomic trajectories required by all subsequent scored steps. The agent must implement the described binary LJ system and run simulations for four compositions.

title: Compute correlation functions for X_B=0.10
action: From the MD trajectory for X_B=0.10, compute the translational order correlation function ρ_G(r) and bond-orientational correlation function Ψ(r). Write the results as a CSV file with columns: r, rho_G, Psi.
description: Produces the raw correlation function curves for X_B=0.10. Checked for structural trends (e.g., at large r both correlations remain high).
output_schema: CSV with three numeric columns: r (reduced distance), rho_G (translational correlation, dimensionless), Psi (orientational correlation, dimensionless). No header.

title: Compute correlation functions for X_B=0.148
action: From the MD trajectory for X_B=0.148, compute the translational order correlation function ρ_G(r) and bond-orientational correlation function Ψ(r). Write the results as a CSV file with columns: r, rho_G, Psi.
description: Produces the raw correlation function curves for X_B=0.148. Checked for structural trends (transitional behaviour: ρ_G short-ranged, Ψ still quasi-long-ranged).
output_schema: CSV with three numeric columns: r (reduced distance), rho_G (translational correlation, dimensionless), Psi (orientational correlation, dimensionless). No header.

title: Compute correlation functions for X_B=0.172
action: From the MD trajectory for X_B=0.172, compute the translational order correlation function ρ_G(r) and bond-orientational correlation function Ψ(r). Write the results as a CSV file with columns: r, rho_G, Psi.
description: Key load-bearing artifact: the intermediate hexatic-like phase at X_B=0.172. The checker verifies that ρ_G decays rapidly but Ψ remains quasi-long-ranged. This step cannot be bypassed without genuinely running the MD simulation.
output_schema: CSV with three numeric columns: r (reduced distance), rho_G (translational correlation, dimensionless), Psi (orientational correlation, dimensionless). No header.

title: Compute correlation functions for X_B=0.25
action: From the MD trajectory for X_B=0.25, compute the translational order correlation function ρ_G(r) and bond-orientational correlation function Ψ(r). Write the results as a CSV file with columns: r, rho_G, Psi.
description: Produces the raw correlation function curves for X_B=0.25. Checked for structural trends (both correlations decay exponentially at short distances).
output_schema: CSV with three numeric columns: r (reduced distance), rho_G (translational correlation, dimensionless), Psi (orientational correlation, dimensionless). No header.

title: Determine compositional window of hexatic-like phase
action: From the computed correlation functions for all four compositions, identify the compositional range where translational order is short-ranged (ρ_G decays to near zero over the sample) while orientational order remains quasi-long-ranged. Output a JSON file with the lower and upper bounds.
description: Synthesizes the correlation function data into the reported compositional window. The checker compares the bounds to the paper-reported window with tolerance.
output_schema: JSON object with numeric keys: "lower_bound" (float) and "upper_bound" (float).
